Hymn 245: This House We Dedicate to Thee
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: D Major
Composer: Frank W. Asper
Lyricist/Text Author: Henry W. Naisbitt
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 245 titled "This House We Dedicate to Thee" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Frank W. Asper and the lyrics were written by Henry W. Naisbitt.
